items.summary: Make the Council Runtime CLI primary and the web console a run viewer, matching every shipped result since August.

claims.text: The web app took its last feature commit (C-06) on 2026-07-06, with its 52nd migration and concierge/audit-log functions still unapplied/undeployed.
Every shipped result from 2026-08-17 to 2026-10-21 ran via local CLI dispatch scripts, briefs, and SYNTHESIS.md without Supabase.
maestroclaw council and maestroclaw skills execute directly from the CLI without loading Supabase config.

items.summary: Move Powers 9 and 10 up to Weeks 1-2, move Power 6 top-k/ablation and Power 7 LLM auto-harvest down, and cut Power 8's synthetic reader swarm.

claims.text: Three of four council adapters (agy_cli, claude_code, kimi_cli) currently declare sandbox mode 'none' on Windows.
Minimum-sufficient top-k routing starves the grading flywheel unless paired with a shadow council exploration sampler.
Ungrounded models in the 09-06 and 10-18 studies had the highest false/permissive rates, whereas grounded seats plus emulator passes caught real defects.

items.summary: Fix the dissent role to one seat instead of rotating, run verifier checks between R1 and R2, prompt only on contested items, and cap at 2 rounds.

claims.text: Rotating the mandatory dissent seat each round forces stance changes that conflict with stopping on full-matrix stance stability.
Appending full round outputs to DEBATE.md risks hitting agy_cli's ~5-minute response window on large payloads.

items.summary: Harden verdict.ts and matrix.ts against unchecked self-attestation, fix the agy_cli re-ask argv bug, and derive tool/file telemetry from the harness.

claims.text: groundedItem() in matrix.ts marks an item grounded if any single claim has status==='verified', ignoring attestation.ran_verifier and evidence validity.
extractVerdict() accepts any non-array JSON object as 'parsed' without validating attestation or items, and run.ts only re-asks on 'truncated'.
runSeat() writes COUNCIL_PROMPT.md for agy_cli on initial dispatch to avoid ENAMETOOLONG, but passes reaskPrompt() (up to 20KB tail + full brief) as raw argv on re-ask.
Existing unit tests in packages/maestroclaw/test/council.test.ts pass 5/5.

items.summary: Proposal §3 misses employer/personal leaks in docs/audits/maestro/, MAESTRO_STATE.md, HISTORY.md, AGENTS.md, grading-lab/, graphify-out/, and .michael/*.zip.

claims.text: docs/audits/maestro/2026-09-22-vision-council/ (which §3 keeps as the worked example) names DSBN and local C:\New folder paths.
MAESTRO_STATE.md, HISTORY.md, CLAW_MODE_SPEC.md, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, and grading-lab/ contain hhlnadxbrdwxcxwfbvwh, hdcsnags, and Michael-Thomas_dsbn.
AGENTS.md hardcodes C:\New folder\Elianas RhythmMigrate\CONCIERGE.md and graphify-out/manifest.json indexes eliana-wordstudy-*-mthomas.ts.
.michael/MiroFish-main.zip (AGPL-3.0), .michael/RyseEnergyDrinks-main.zip, and root PNGs are tracked in git.

items.summary: The Discovery/Brainstorm workflow is sound, but cross-account web-to-Claw routing is blocked in code; ship a single-workspace council_run job first.

claims.text: useOrchestration.ts explicitly filters out provider_group === 'maestroclaw' from broadcast().
packages/maestroclaw/src/index.ts only polls build_session and single-adapter executeJob, with no multi-seat council job runner.
executor-api poll and claim enforce .eq('requested_by', executor.owner_user_id), blocking a second user account from using Michael's executor.

items.summary: Add a Context Packer & Blindness Scrubber power (council pack) and address non-Codex Windows unsandboxed execution and CLI subscription ToS risks.

claims.text: makeCopy() in run.ts only strips session.log, .maestroclaw-session.log, and COUNCIL_PROMPT.md, leaving MAESTRO_STATE.md/STATE.md exposed in clones.
agy_cli runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions and sandbox disabled by default on Windows.

open_questions: Whether public release will use a squashed orphan git branch so git log history does not leak scrubbed files and emails.
Whether delegated executor sharing for a second user account should be scoped at the workspace table level with an explicit job_type allowlist (council_run only).
